<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem Animation</title>
  
  <style>
    .font-title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; }
    .font-body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #334155; }
    .font-math { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; }
    .font-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; fill: #ffffff; }
    
    @keyframes shiftA {
      0%, 20% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; }
      40%, 80% { transform: translate(270px, -70px); opacity: 0.9; }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; }
    }
    
    @keyframes shiftB {
      0%, 20% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; }
      40%, 80% { transform: translate(-70px, 200px); opacity: 0.9; }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 1; }
    }

    .anim-a {
      animation: shiftA 6s infinite ease-in-out;
      transform-origin: 300px 300px;
    }
    
    .anim-b {
      animation: shiftB 6s infinite ease-in-out;
      transform-origin: 200px 400px;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" />

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="400" y="38" text-anchor="middle" class="font-title">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>
  <text x="400" y="64" text-anchor="middle" class="font-body">In any right-angled triangle, the area of squares on a and b equals the area of c².</text>

  <!-- Left Side: The Right-Angled Triangle with Squares -->
  <g transform="translate(60, 100)">
    <defs>
      <pattern id="grid" width="30" height="30" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
        <path d="M 30 0 L 0 0 0 30" fill="none" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1"/>
      </pattern>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- Square on b (bottom, 4x4 = 120x120) -->
    <rect x="90" y="120" width="120" height="120" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Square on a (left, 3x3 = 90x90) -->
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="90" height="90" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#f97316" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Square on hypotenuse c -->
    <polygon points="90,30 210,120 120,240 0,150" fill="#fef08a" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

    <!-- The Triangle itself -->
    <polygon points="90,120 90,30 0,120" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="3" />
    
    <!-- Right angle marker -->
    <polyline points="90,105 75,105 75,120" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Labels for sides -->
    <text x="35" y="70" class="font-math">a</text>
    <text x="105" y="180" class="font-math">b</text>
    <text x="160" y="75" class="font-math">c</text>
    
    <!-- Labels inside squares -->
    <text x="40" y="80" class="font-label" text-anchor="middle">a²</text>
    <text x="150" y="185" class="font-label" text-anchor="middle">b²</text>
    <text x="105" y="135" class="font-label" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b">c²</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Right Side: Animated Area Demonstration -->
  <g transform="translate(470, 95)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="270" height="340" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" rx="10"/>
    
    <text x="135" y="30" text-anchor="middle" class="font-math">Visual Proof of Areas</text>
    <text x="135" y="52" text-anchor="middle" class="font-body" font-size="13px">Area a² (orange) and Area b² (blue)</text>
    <text x="135" y="70" text-anchor="middle" class="font-body" font-size="13px">combine to fill Area c² (yellow)</text>

    <!-- Container for Hypotenuse Square Outline -->
    <rect x="35" y="100" width="200" height="200" fill="#fef08a" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2" rx="4"/>
    <text x="135" y="205" text-anchor="middle" class="font-title" fill="#ca8a04">c²</text>

    <!-- Animated Square A -->
    <g class="anim-a">
      <rect x="35" y="220" width="80" height="80" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#f97316" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="75" y="265" text-anchor="middle" class="font-math">a²</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Animated Square B -->
    <g class="anim-b">
      <rect x="115" y="100" width="120" height="120" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="175" y="165" text-anchor="middle" class="font-math">b²</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Key Labels pointing to components -->
  <g class="font-body" font-size="13px">
    <line x1="220" y1="170" x2="270" y2="170" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="278" y="175" font-weight="bold">Hypotenuse (c)</text>
    <text x="278" y="193" fill="#64748b" font-size="12px">Longest side, opposite</text>
    <text x="278" y="209" fill="#64748b" font-size="12px">the right angle</text>

    <!-- Formula summary footer inside bounds -->
    <rect x="60" y="440" width="680" height="42" fill="#e2e8f0" rx="6" />
    <text x="400" y="466" text-anchor="middle" class="font-math" fill="#1e293b" font-size="16px">
      If a = 3 and b = 4, then c² = 3² + 4² = 25, so c = 5.
    </text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow marker definition -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#0f172a"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis GCSE Biology Diagram</title>
  <style>
    /* CSS Animations */
    @keyframes floatParticle {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(var(--moveX), var(--moveY)); opacity: 0; }
    }
    
    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(40,200,80,0.4)); }
      50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(40,200,80,0.9)); }
    }

    @keyframes sunRay {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(1.05); }
    }

    .sun-animated {
      transform-origin: 100px 90px;
      animation: sunRay 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .chloroplast {
      animation: pulseGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .co2-particle {
      animation: floatParticle 3s linear infinite;
    }

    .h2o-particle {
      animation: floatParticle 3.5s linear infinite;
    }

    .o2-particle {
      animation: floatParticle 2.5s linear infinite;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter GCSE Chemistry Diagram</title>

  <style>
    /* Particle Vibration in Solid */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      20% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
      40% { transform: translate(2px, -1px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-1px, -2px); }
      80% { transform: translate(1px, 2px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    /* Particle Flow in Liquid */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: translate(15px, -12px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: translate(-15px, 15px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: translate(12px, 12px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    /* Rapid Gas Motion */
    @keyframes gas1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-45px, -35px); }
      50% { transform: translate(30px, -50px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-25px, 40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(50px, 30px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-40px, -25px); }
      75% { transform: translate(35px, -40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-30px, 45px); }
      50% { transform: translate(45px, 35px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-50px, -30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    .vibrate-group { animation: vibrate 0.25s infinite linear; }
    
    .f1 { animation: flow1 2s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .f2 { animation: flow2 2.3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .f3 { animation: flow3 1.8s infinite ease-in-out; }

    .g1 { animation: gas1 0.9s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g2 { animation: gas2 0.7s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g3 { animation: gas3 0.8s infinite ease-in-out; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" />

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="400" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">States of Matter</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID PANEL ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 70)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="220" height="320" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" />
    <rect x="20" y="20" width="180" height="180" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9" />
    <text x="110" y="235" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">Solid</text>
    <text x="110" y="265" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">Close together &</text>
    <text x="110" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">vibrate in fixed positions</text>

    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular Lattice + Vibration) -->
    <g class="vibrate-group" transform="translate(50, 45)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="20" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <circle cx="100" cy="20" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle cx="20" cy="60" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <circle cx="100" cy="60" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle cx="20" cy="100" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="100" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
      <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="14" fill="#3b82f6" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID PANEL ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(290, 70)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="220" height="320" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" />
    <rect x="20" y="20" width="180" height="180" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9" />
    <text x="110" y="235" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#16a34a">Liquid</text>
    <text x="110" y="265" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">Close together but</text>
    <text x="110" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">move past each other</text>

    <!-- Liquid Particles (Irregular + Flow Animation) -->
    <g transform="translate(45, 40)">
      <circle cx="30" cy="30" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f1" />
      <circle cx="70" cy="25" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f2" />
      <circle cx="110" cy="35" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f3" />
      <circle cx="20" cy="75" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f3" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="70" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f1" />
      <circle cx="100" cy="80" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f2" />
      <circle cx="40" cy="115" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f2" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="120" r="14" fill="#22c55e" class="f3" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS PANEL ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(540, 70)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="220" height="320" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" />
    <rect x="20" y="20" width="180" height="180" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9" />
    <text x="110" y="235" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ea580c">Gas</text>
    <text x="110" y="265" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">Far apart &</text>
    <text x="110" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">move fast in all directions</text>

    <!-- Gas Particles (Spread out + Fast Random Motion) -->
    <g transform="translate(50, 45)">
      <circle cx="20" cy="30" r="14" fill="#f97316" class="g1" />
      <circle cx="110" cy="25" r="14" fill="#f97316" class="g2" />
      <circle cx="65" cy="90" r="14" fill="#f97316" class="g3" />
      <circle cx="120" cy="130" r="14" fill="#f97316" class="g1" />
      <circle cx="25" cy="140" r="14" fill="#f97316" class="g2" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== ARROWS / ENERGY ADDITION ==================== -->
  <!-- Solid to Liquid Arrow -->
  <g transform="translate(255, 210)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="25" y2="0" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <polygon points="25,-5 35,0 25,5" fill="#64748b" />
    <text x="17" y="-12" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b">Heat</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Liquid to Gas Arrow -->
  <g transform="translate(505, 210)">
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="25" y2="0" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <polygon points="25,-5 35,0 25,5" fill="#64748b" />
    <text x="17" y="-12" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b">Heat</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer instruction -->
  <text x="400" y="440" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#334155">Heating a substance transfers energy, making particles move faster and break bonds.</text>
  <text x="400" y="465" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#64748b">GCSE Chemistry Revision - Particle Model</text>

</svg>
